about: IPMA's own forecast for Lisbon (globalIdLocal 1110600): the 5-day daily forecast and the hourly model forecast (mean wind, no gusts). IPMA's wind classes: 1 weak, 2 moderate, 3 strong, 4 very strong.

hourly_runs.note: values changed between the 20:22 and 21:18 reads with the same dataUpdate stamp

code_tables.note: Decoded with IPMA's own id tables. The hourly feed's idIntensidadePrecipita (rain_intensity_class) is decoded with precipitation-classe.json, assumed the same scale as the daily classPrecInt; IPMA does not say so. idTipoTempo (weather_type_id) uses weather-type-classe.json.
